IIST CAMPUS · VERSION 5

Built from the map.

This version uses campus corrections supplied on 30 October 2026: named hostels, separate SAC, OAT and Multipurpose Hall, covered walks, steps, lower and upper terraces, deep ponds and sloping roads.

Tar roads have grass verges and shade trees. The central hostel area has bamboo; the roundabout has a garden and high-mast light. Heights in metres, boundary details and building outlines remain approximate. Ardra is building 14; Arundhathy is building 18. The water tank stands on a four-pillar concrete tower on the Phalguni terrace. No building interiors are included.

Guide the chibi girl with WASD or arrow keys. Hold Shift to run and press Space to jump. The camera follows her; move the mouse or drag to rotate it, and scroll to change its distance. Click the scene to capture the mouse, or drag to look when capture is unavailable. Press V for an aerial view. On touch screens, use the arrow pad, the Jump button, and drag the scene.

The minimap shows your position. Use “Go to a place” to travel quickly. Campus layout coverage is limited to the supplied map.
